body:
## Pull request overview This pull request adds pagination support to the ListNodes gRPC API endpoint, enabling clients to retrieve nodes in pages rather than all at once. This is particularly useful for large-scale deployments with many nodes. **Changes:** - Extended protobuf definitions with pagination parameters (`limit`, `offset`) in `ListNodesRequest` and total count in `ListNodesResponse` - Implemented paginated database queries for both all nodes and user-specific nodes - Updated the gRPC API handler to support both paginated and legacy (non-paginated) modes for backward compatibility - Enhanced CLI with pagination flags and pagination info display ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | proto/headscale/v1/node.proto | Added `limit` and `offset` fields to `ListNodesRequest`, added `total` field to `ListNodesResponse` | | gen/go/headscale/v1/node.pb.go | Auto-generated protobuf code reflecting the proto changes | | hscontrol/db/node.go | Implemented `ListNodesPaginated` function with database-level pagination | | hscontrol/db/users.go | Implemented `ListNodesByUserPaginated` function for user-filtered pagination | | hscontrol/state/state.go | Added state-layer wrapper methods for pagination with NodeView conversion | | hscontrol/grpcv1.go | Updated `ListNodes` handler to support pagination while maintaining backward compatibility | | hscontrol/db/node_test.go | Added comprehensive unit tests for pagination functionality | | cmd/headscale/cli/nodes.go | Added `--limit` and `--offset` flags with pagination info display |
